$comment: FORM P4-T2: functions[] is rung 2 of the ladder, the answer to 'we need a keyword for a named computation'. Six slots: the function def (name, params, returns, body, description) and the pack's functions array.

declarative.why: a function says WHAT value it is (a typed pure expression over its parameters); no ordering, loop or temporary variable

notLower.why: an inline expression cannot be named and reused; without functions each repeated computation (surge, fare) needed its own keyword or an eleven-step chain of `set` steps

taught.bundleLine: Function | functions[] | A named pure computation: {"name":"surgeFactor","params":[...],"returns":"decimal","body":"..."}, then call surgeFactor(x) in any expression (a pack's: pack::name). The body reads only its parameters.

replaces: flows[].steps chains of set steps used only as arithmetic (ride-hailing PriceRide, 11 steps -> 2)
